unfed.why: keeps seen isoDates in n8n's workflow static data (an in-n8n store no fixture source can seed); a manual run starts with none

branches: IF-1: true for the techcommunity.microsoft.com link (Telegram_M365)
IF-2: true for the Exchange vulnerability story (Telegram_Security), false for the other four (Telegram_IT)
expect.offline: only get new RSS keeps the seen isoDates in workflow static data, which a manual run does not persist, so every run starts with none and the first feed passes whole; later feeds pass the items whose isoDate is new in the run. The fifth feed URL in RSS Source is mangled by the template export's secret scrubber (YOUR_AWS_SECRET_KEY_HERE in place of the path); the overlay restores Microsoft Tech Community's blog RSS path. Telegram's chat id is the template's placeholder 'TelegramID', filled by the overlay
